Amazing Dining Experience
Jun 2026 • Solo
The restaurant is now called POT AU PHO 2.0 with a brand new concept.

 A seat at the counter of POT AU PHO 2.0 - @potaupho2.0 - is not merely a meal; it is a masterclass in the evolution of Vietnamese identity. 
Tucked away in the heartbeat of Saigon, this intimate 14-seat sanctuary strips back the familiar to reveal the structural brilliance of a national icon.

Chef Peter Cuong Franklin - @petercuongfranklin - orchestrates a sublime dialogue here, moving far beyond mere reconstruction. Within this sleek, atmospheric setting, he stands at the center of the stage—not as a distant executive, but as a host engaging directly with diners. His omakase-style service turns the kitchen into a laboratory of culture. Watching him perform is to witness years of technical rigor and deep reverence for heritage crystallized into every precise movement.

The experience is a profound exploration of depth, balance, and the intersection of French finesse and Vietnamese soul. Each course serves as a technical showcase, challenging perceptions while honoring the aromatic logic of the streets. The service is both poised and personal, reflecting a philosophy that treats tradition as a living, breathing language rather than a stagnant relic.

To dine here is to see the future of Vietnamese gastronomy—sophisticated, bold, and rooted in an unwavering respect for the land. For those seeking a deeper understanding of what modern Vietnamese cuisine can achieve, this is an essential pilgrimage. A truly elevated, unforgettable encounter with the heart of Saigon.

Aggressive upselling tactics, without taking care of customer service satisfaction
May 2026 • Friends
A recent dinner at a Michelin-starred restaurant in Saigon was a letdown, to say the least 😔. After enjoying a meal next door at An'an, the owner invited us to try his new concept, which we accepted as a courtesy. Unfortunately, the evening took a sour turn when the bartender served me a glass of pinot noir without mentioning the hefty price tag of 1,600,000 Dong per glass. What's more, when I expressed my disappointment, the owner and bartender showed a disturbing lack of empathy. In a surprising display of insensitivity, the owner even congratulated the bartender on his actions. I sincerely hope that this restaurant will take customer satisfaction more seriously in the future.

Dining experience at Pot Au Pho 🍲 by Anan, Le Chef Menu, a homage to Phở
Jul 2024 • Family
We have dined in Anan on number of occasions but we have never tried Le Chef Menu Homage to Phở 🍲 as I thought a Phở menu would be too filling but we tried it this time and I am happy to report that the menu was really well thought out, well-balanced and well-portioned and most importantly tasted delicious. We still got to sense all the fragrances and taste all the great flovours in the traditional Phở but elevated to a new heights. Each dish is created and presented beautifully and creatively, if you love Phở, try this out for yourself, come with an empty stomach and an open mind, I am sure your tastebuds are in for a real treat. I highly recommend this menu at Pot Au Pho 🍲

Not recommend
Jan 2024 • Friends
It was really disappointing to return to this place after the restaurant received a Michelin rating. I've been here twice before and everything is great from the space, the delicious food and, most importantly, the feeling of complete enjoyment. Right now, it's very messy because it's too crowded, everything seems to be forcing people to eat quickly, and most importantly, the food portion has been reduced (specifically, the foie gras spring rolls have exactly 2 pieces compared to before. that is 4). More importantly, the boss or manager's way of asking questions is very difficult to listen to (asking questions in English), but after knowing that he is Vietnamese, he seems to look down on him. Maybe the restaurant only suits and favors international customers! I spent nearly 3 million VND for 2 people but in the end I couldn't fully enjoy it. Do not recommend or recommend this place. Hopefully the restaurant will improve to maintain its Michelin star.
